exposure: transfusion of more than 10 red blood cell units (RBCUs)
embolization of both uterine and ovarian arteries
cohort: 117 consecutive patients who underwent PAE for PPH between January 2006 and June 2013
finding: Pelvic arterial embolization (PAE) for postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) was found to be a safe and effective alternative to hysterectomy, with a high success rate and low complication rate.
